info.name: Ecommerce Influencer API — Complete Parent, Child, Wallet & Payout Flow
info.description:
Route-complete collection generated from referral-mobile.routes.js, referral-mobile.validation.js, auth.routes.js and file-uploader.routes.js.

Run Parent/Child Login first. Protected folders inherit the correct bearer token.

Ledger status: pending, locked, available, payout_requested, paid, reversed, expired, plus payout request statuses.

commissionType: code_owner_base, code_owner_bonus, direct_parent, lifetime_override, performance_bonus, reversal, withdrawal, coin_expiry, manual_adjustment.

transactionType: credit_coins, debit_coins, locked_coins, released_coins, reversed_coins, withdrawal_coins, expired_coins.

Payout state: available coins → requested/reserved → approved/awaiting transfer → Admin transfer + UTR + proof → paid coins.

item.name: 00 - Influencer Authentication
item.description: Influencer accounts use /auth/influencer/login. Parent and child access/refresh tokens are captured automatically.

item.name: Parent Login (run first)
item.description: Logs in an active parent influencer and saves parentAccessToken and parentRefreshToken.

request.description: Logs in an active parent influencer and saves parentAccessToken and parentRefreshToken.

item.name: Refresh Parent Token
item.description: Rotates the parent influencer session tokens.

request.description: Rotates the parent influencer session tokens.

item.name: Child Login (run first)
item.description: Logs in an active child influencer and saves childAccessToken and childRefreshToken.

request.description: Logs in an active child influencer and saves childAccessToken and childRefreshToken.

item.name: Refresh Child Token
item.description: Rotates the child influencer session tokens.

request.description: Rotates the child influencer session tokens.

request.description: Returns role, profile state, navigation modules, routes, and capabilities.

request.description: Orders whose referral coins are still inside fulfillment/return-window lock.

item.name: My Child Network (Parent only)
item.description: Parent-only direct child list with sales, orders, customers and earnings summaries. Saves the first associate ID for the detail request. Filters: pending|active|suspended|rejected.

request.description: Parent-only direct child list with sales, orders, customers and earnings summaries. Saves the first associate ID for the detail request. Filters: pending|active|suspended|rejected.

item.name: Associate Complete Tracking Detail (Parent only)
item.description: Parent-authorized detail for one direct associate. Returns identity/contact and account states, referral performance, customer/order totals, wallet balances, 10 recent orders, 10 recent coin activities, and bonus progress. A parent cannot inspect another parent's associate.

request.description: Parent-authorized detail for one direct associate. Returns identity/contact and account states, referral performance, customer/order totals, wallet balances, 10 recent orders, 10 recent coin activities, and bonus progress. A parent cannot inspect another parent's associate.

item.description: All fields are optional, but at least one is required. Upload files first and place returned URLs in environment variables.

item.name: Create Brand Associate / Child
item.description: Parent-only. Creates an active child and returns temporaryPassword. Save it securely and change the environment child credentials if testing the new account.

request.description: Parent-only. Creates an active child and returns temporaryPassword. Save it securely and change the environment child credentials if testing the new account.

item.description: Supported image types: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF; maximum 10 MB. Copy data.url into profileImageUrl.

request.description: Supported image types: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF; maximum 10 MB. Copy data.url into profileImageUrl.

item.description: Upload the QR first, then copy data.url into payoutQrUrl before creating a UPI QR payout.

request.description: Upload the QR first, then copy data.url into payoutQrUrl before creating a UPI QR payout.

item.description: Supported document types: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP. Copy data.url into the appropriate profile document URL.

request.description: Supported document types: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP. Copy data.url into the appropriate profile document URL.

item.name: Upload Multiple Images
item.description: Optional shared uploader. Accepts up to 10 images.
